theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl n → (Eucl n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), MeasurableSet S → Measurable f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed C ∧ C ⊆ S ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (S \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn f C
